verdict.rationale: The public how-to-form page says the entity forms are fillable PDFs that can be submitted by mail or upload, which implies they can be downloaded from the site. The same page openly publishes formation guidance on name reservation, registered agents and certificates, with no login step mentioned. missing for 10: an explicit statement that form PDFs download without an account, form-specific instruction documents, and hands-on or independent confirmation of the downloads.
